changelog.entry: A difficulty choice at the top of the page: Easy, Normal or Hard, Normal by default and remembered on this device. Easy opens the nudge and the hint together on the first press, puts the answer one press away without the extra question, and counts one chip over the reference as par. Hard has no answer step and fewer free undos, and keeps its own par marks. Normal is the game exactly as it was, nothing is locked by any choice, and every achievement can be earned on Normal.

Optional soft sound, off unless you turn it on in Settings (Sound): a quiet click as a wire is connected and a lower one as it is removed, a gentle tone when a circuit matches its table, and a bell when it earns you a new chip. The sounds are made in your browser (no sound files), stay silent in a hidden tab, and have a volume and a Reduce sounds switch. Nothing in the game depends on them.

The Desktop page now shows each level's par and board space (under the goal sentence), the same line the Classic page already had. New: the two small boxes on every board marked tie 1 and tie 0 are explained. Hover one for a note, read the line under the board's wire key, or see the new tutorial step: they are fixed inputs, a wire tied to 1 or to 0 for good, so a circuit can be given a constant (for example, tie one input of a NAND chip to 1 and it becomes an inverter).
Logic Gates is new: wire AND, OR, NOT and XOR chips so the lamps match the table. Every solved circuit becomes a chip you keep.
